narration: Where are the dining chairs? Here, a low table meets people seated on the floor. This small Korean table is called a soban. It could hold a meal and also carry the dishes into a room. Moved away after use, it suited a room serving more than one purpose. Look at the height of the bowls, the hands, and the seated bodies. A visitor might wonder how to sit as much as what was being served. This is one chosen scene, rather than a picture of every household. The work is attributed to Uncho. From the TJ Kim Collection, a small piece of furniture helps us read the shape of a day.
